response.sql: SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, o.mktnote AS mktnote, AVG(f.rebrate) AS avg_rebrate, SUM(f.rebtotal) AS total_rebate FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote ORDER BY (SUM(f.rebtotal) IS NULL) ASC, SUM(f.rebtotal) DESC LIMIT 10
